Name: Witch's Garden Flowers for AT and DGA
Author: prerona2411
Description:
As the title says, this is a conversion of the original [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5386]Witch's Garden Flowers[/url] by Squiver to AT and DGA :) You can find the conversions as separate files, download whichever you choose!(or download both if you want :3)

[list]
[*]The [color=#00ff00]AT file[/color] turns two pieces of furniture into 10 pretty herbs for your witchy aesthetic needs: 
[/list][b]          House Plant[/b]: Yarrow, Wormwood, Hollyhock & Rue 
[b]          Coffee Table[/b]: Belladonna, Hemlock, Sage, Stinging Nettle, Borage & Chamomile

[list]
[*]The [color=#00ff00]DGA file [/color]turns the plants into standalone furniture with little descriptions for each of them. You can buy them from the Hat Mouse on Fridays for 750g each!
[/list]
[b][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#ffff00][size=5]Instructions![/size]

[/color][size=4]1) For the AT Version[/size]
[/font][/b]- Make sure you have the latest versions of SMAPI and Alternative Textures installed
- Buy a [b]Paint Bucket[/b] from Robin
- Use the Paint Bucket on the furniture mentioned above, and pick a plant!

[size=4][b]2) For the DGA Version [color=#00ff00](NEW!)[/color]
[/b][/size]- Make sure you have Dynamic Game Assets installed, and the Hat Mouse store unlocked
- Go to the mouse's shop on [b]Fridays[/b] to buy the plants!

[i]This is the first mod I've ever released, so any feedback would be greatly appreciated :D[/i]


[i][font=Trebuchet MS][color=#9fc5e8][size=3][b](why did you turn a coffee table into plants??)[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[/i]Some of the plants from the original mod were a tad wider than the pixel width of a house plant, so I searched for an alternative piece of furniture that was wider, easily available and could also be placed outside! Just make sure you have the coffee table in the [u]same configuration[/u] as the one in my mod picture, if you rotate the table and use the Paint Bucket, you'll just get an invisible plant.
